findings.summary: Blind keyboard driver cannot clear the 3-tile pit (gap x≈420-545) — three falls exhaust the 3 in-level hearts by t≈8.0s, so the win path was not reached; gaps are humanly clearable (full jump arcs ≈160px vs the 120px gap) but the driver's 0.09s Space taps get chopped to vy=-4 by the variable-jump release check, giving ≈72px hops.

Rig recorded win=true at t≈8.0 for what is actually a LOSS — the result overlay reads TRY AGAIN (sim-results verdictNote: 'result overlay text did not clearly read as a win'); the rig treats any #screen-result activation as the win signal, so the recorded win flag must not be trusted for keyboard-driven platformers.
Gold level-title label 'Greenway Gallop' drawn beside the goal flag is clipped by the right canvas edge of the 960px-wide world.

No EN+FR controls string anywhere for this level: level.json carries no meta field at all and the in-game hint is the genre module's English-only string ('← → / A D move · SPACE / ↑ jump · reach the flag').

Rig edge-coverage windows (pause@70%/blur@82%/mash@90% of the 240s budget) never fire because the run ends at t≈8.0 on the loss overlay; a manual probe on the same level covered them instead: pause overlay appears with correct subtext and freezes state exactly, resume works, mash Escape re-pauses (game left paused after mash), and window blur does NOT auto-pause — the hero kept simulating and fell into the pit while unfocused (hearts 3→2 between probe t3.48 and t4.71); zero console/page errors across the whole probe.

Audio toggle exists (title-screen ♪ button plus SOUND screen with MUSIC / SOUND FX / MASTER rows, persisted via settings) but is unreachable during play — the pause menu offers only RESUME/RESTART/LEVEL SELECT/QUIT.

Two 404s on every boot: assets/logo-all.svg and assets/logo-in.svg referenced by the title-screen brand images do not exist on disk (rig filters them as booth-benign, but they are genuinely missing files).

In-level hearts render as ~10px glyphs in the 960px booth capture — clearly hearts at 3× zoom but the smallest, weakest HUD element, while the bank ♥×N, ★ counter and title all read fine at booth distance.
